title: Tricks keypad stops advancing while the total is over 13, so re-typing a full column top to bottom overwrites the row above
steps: Round 4 with all four tricks already entered (3,2,1,7)
Tap יוסי's row, then tap 4, 1, 2, 6 intending יוסי 4, Maya 1, Dan 2, נועה 6
expected: Each tap lands on the next row, as it does on empty rows
actual: After 4 the total is 14 so the highlight stays on יוסי; 1 overwrites יוסי, then the highlight moves on: result יוסי 1, Maya 2, Dan 6, נועה 7 (16/13, Save disabled)
why_it_matters: Correcting a whole round at the table is exactly when people type down the column; the 13-total check blocks most wrong saves, but the user has to work out what happened
evidence: ~ [10] button "Tricks for יוסי: 1" … ~ [16] button "Tricks for Dan: 6" … (alert) Tricks must total 13 — now 16
suggested_fix: Advance after every tap (as on empty rows) and let the over-13 alert do the warning, or advance to the next row explicitly chosen by the user

title: Race notice says 'The table you picked was not started' when the other phone started the very same table
where: /session/:id 'Same players' after another phone started it
steps: Two phones as Maya on the same open session
Phone A taps 'Same players as last round — Dan bids first'
Phone B taps the same button
expected: A softer line when the tables match (e.g. 'Your table was already started on another phone')
actual: 'It was started with Dan, נועה, יוסי and Maya. The table you picked was not started.' — same four, same order
why_it_matters: Makes the user think something differs when nothing does
evidence: v4-b output: alertdialog 'A round was just started on another phone' — 'It was started with Dan, נועה, יוסי and Maya. The table you picked was not started.'
suggested_fix: Compare the picked table with the open round's and drop the second sentence when equal

title: First-bidder mark is missing on the round card, the round page and Edit round
steps: In round 5 tap Dan (seat 2) as first bidder; save
Look at the card, the round page and Edit round
expected: Per the seat-order ruling, the first bidder is marked wherever the round is shown
actual: Bidding and Results show 'Dan first bid'; the card, round page and Edit round show Dan with no mark (only the trump winner's suit icon)
why_it_matters: With seat order fixed, the mark is the only way to tell later who opened the bidding
evidence: Edit round 5 listing: '[10] Dan / bid 5 · made +35' (no 'first bid')
suggested_fix: Show the same 'first bid' tag on the card, round page and edit view

title: Activity inside a group lists other groups' notes under that group's header
steps: Inside Thursday Whist open Menu › Activity
expected: Either only this group's notes, or a clear 'all groups' label
actual: Under the THURSDAY WHIST header the feed includes 'Anonymous left a note about נועה — Family Table' and 'נועה left a note about אמא — Family Table'; no tab is highlighted
why_it_matters: Small mixed-context signal; each card does name its group
suggested_fix: Filter to the current group, or add an 'All groups' subtitle

title: 'Round 3 saved' note stays on screen after closing the session
expected: The saved note goes away (or is replaced by 'Session closed')
actual: Closed session page still shows '(alert) Round 3 saved' above FINAL RESULT
